notes:
Local Activity history and updater usability improvements.

- Records application starts and successful conversation actions.
- Records model-download and update outcomes using fixed summaries.
- Activity does not store chat text, conversation titles, paths, or raw errors.
- Activity shows the newest 200 events and retains at most 1,000.
- Events older than 30 days are pruned when Activity storage is accessed.
- Clearing Activity does not delete conversations.
- Update state is preserved across tabs.
- Update operations guard sidebar navigation, app shortcuts, and Settings controls.
- Tray Quit is blocked while this build performs an update installation.

Alpha software: installation-guard behavior still needs an upgrade test from this version.
